camel_example: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountPasswordZonal --region cn-hangzhou --NewAccountPassword Pw123456 --DBClusterId 'pc-**************' --AccountName testacc
description_en: Modifies the password of an account for PolarDB on ENS
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-account-password-zonal --db-cluster-id 'pc-**************' --account-name testacc --new-account-password Pw123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountPasswordZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the edge cluster. This operation applies only to zonal edge clusters. You can obtain a valid ID by calling the DescribeDBClustersZonal operation. Standard PolarDB cluster IDs are not supported. For standard clusters, use the ModifyAccountPassword operation
parameters.help_zh: 边缘集群 ID。本接口仅适用于 Zonal 边缘集群，可通过 DescribeDBClustersZonal 获取有效 ID；标准 PolarDB 集群 ID 不适用。标准集群应使用 ModifyAccountPassword
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password of the account. The password must meet the following requirements:
Contains at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Is 8 to 32 characters in length.
Special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh:
账号的新密码，需符合如下要求：
至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
长度为8~32个字符。
特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: new_account_password

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
